dataset_identity.publisher: Jabatan Pengangkutan Jalan (JPJ) / Ministry of Transport Malaysia
dataset_identity.grain: One row is one car registration transaction.
interpretation: These are registration transactions, not vehicle sales, purchases, customers, or demand.
date_reg is the registration date and may differ from a purchase date.
Rakan Niaga is retained as a registration channel and is not treated as a geographic state.
greendiesel remains a separate source fuel category.
The latest yearly file may be a partial year.

column_roles.date_reg: Registration date. This may differ from a purchase date.
column_roles.fuel: Source fuel code. greendiesel is retained as its own category.
column_roles.state: JPJ registration office, or the Rakan Niaga partner channel. Not a place of use.

duplicate_profile.note: Identical source rows were counted and retained. There is no vehicle or transaction identifier, so matching rows are indistinguishable registration transactions rather than rows to delete. Yearly signature counts are added together because date_reg is part of the signature and each date_reg year matches its file year.
